meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

copy.tagline: 让 AI 助手改用 OpenCode 驱动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在用命令行工具管理 AI 智能体
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to OpenCode
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are managing AI agents via command line

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按你的要求把 NanoClaw 的代理后端从默认的 Claude 换成 OpenCode,自动复制代码、安装依赖、重建镜像,并让你选用 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等外部提供商。
howto.when: 当你要求把某个代理组改用 OpenCode 作为后端,或配置 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等外部提供商时触发。

say.text: 帮我给 agent 组配置 DeepSeek 提供商,并切换过去。
say.note: 需要准备好 DeepSeek 的 API 密钥。

say.text: 在 NanoClaw 里集成 OpenCode 并重建镜像。
say.note: 会检查构建和测试是否通过。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can switch NanoClaw's agent backend from the default Claude to OpenCode on request, automatically copying code, installing dependencies, rebuilding the image, and letting you choose external providers like OpenRouter or DeepSeek via config.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to switch an agent group's backend to OpenCode, or to configure an external provider such as OpenRouter or DeepSeek.

say_en.text: Switch NanoClaw's agent backend to OpenCode with OpenRouter models.
say_en.note: Claude will run the skill's install steps.

say_en.text: Set up DeepSeek as the provider for an agent group and switch to it.
say_en.note: Have a DeepSeek API key ready.

say_en.text: Integrate OpenCode into NanoClaw and rebuild the image.
say_en.note: It will run build and validation checks.
